ITEM 1 | Cubes of pale yellow-white fruit with slightly translucent edges, firm, cut into roughly 2 cm cubes, a cluster of about 15 pieces filling roughly 1/8 of the plate on the upper-left | 120
ITEM 2 | Bright green broccoli florets with darker green tips and some stem, slightly glossy, moist, clustered in a mound about 8 cm across near the top center of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Sliced grey-brown meat with a fibrous, slightly shredded texture and dark herb flecks, some browned edges, sitting in a layer about 1 cm thick across the upper-right area | 110
ITEM 4 | Golden-brown flaky pastry roll or wedge with layered, crisp edges, about 7 cm long, next to the meat on the right side | 60
ITEM 5 | Orange carrot pieces with dark charred edges and browned spots, glossy and soft, about 4 cm pieces, clustered in the center of the plate | 70
ITEM 6 | Rectangular slice of pizza with golden melted cheese bubbled and browned in spots, red tomato sauce visible beneath, crust edge golden and crisp, covering about one-fifth of the plate in the lower-right | 210
ITEM 7 | Thin reddish-brown sauce or drippings in small smears near the meat and pastry on the right edge, glossy and slightly thick | 10
